description: テストベース文書から抽出した定義済みID全量と、各ツール呼び出しに実際に渡された母集団を突き合わせ、どの母集団にも渡されていないIDを決定的に検出する。網羅率100%が母集団の縮退による見かけの値でないことを検証する。design_* 系エンジンが発行するコロン区切りの網羅対象ID（BV:/EP:/ST:/DT:/PW:/SC:/UC:/DL:/CFG:）も既定でID索引に含める。

completedTools.description: Already executed tools; entries without evidence are treated as not executed

evidence.description: Evidence of execution: an output file path (e.g. docs/test-cases.md) or an output heading line starting with '#'

outputExcerpt.description: Excerpt of the declared tool's actual output text. Must contain that tool's own H1 heading line; otherwise the declaration is reported as evidence-unverified and still counted as not executed

toolName.description: Name of an already executed tool in this workflow

declaredPopulations.description: Declared ID populations actually passed to each tool call, to be cross-checked against the test basis

ids.description: IDs actually declared/passed to this tool call

label.description: Optional label to disambiguate multiple calls to the same tool

toolName.description: Name of the tool the population was passed to, e.g. extract_test_conditions

documents.description: Test basis documents to extract defined IDs from

content.description: Free-text document content (Markdown / plain text, format agnostic)

exclusions.description: IDs intentionally excluded from population coverage, with reasons

id.description: ID to exclude from the never-declared judgment

reason.description: Reason why this ID is intentionally out of scope

expectedDocumentNames.description: Full list of test basis document names expected to be audited, used to detect missing documents

idPatterns.description: Extra regular expression sources for requirement/feature IDs, added to the default pattern. Capture group count decides how the ID is built: 1 group = group 1 is used as the whole ID as-is (no hyphen joining), 2 groups = reconstructed as `${group1}-${group2}` (default pattern behavior), 0 groups = the whole match is used. Use a 1-group pattern for numeric-only IDs (031), dot-separated IDs (3.1.2) and underscore IDs (REQ_001) so the reported ID matches the notation in the source document. If a given pattern matches nothing, a [high] finding is emitted in the input digest.

includeCoverageTargetIds.description: Include colon-separated coverage target IDs (BV:/EP:/ST:/DT:/PW:/SC:/UC:/DL:/CFG:) emitted by design_* tools in the ID index. Defaults to true.

verbose.description: If false/omitted (default), section 2.1 shows a per-prefix count summary and lists rows only for IDs with status 'never-declared' or 'excluded', and section 2.9's remediation-priority list is capped at a fixed row limit with total/omitted counts noted. If true, lists every defined-ID row and every priority row in full (as in previous versions).
